remaining_gaps: Own-terms end not dated: section 3(e) ends the National Commission on America's Urban Families 30 days after it submits its report, and section 2(b), as amended by EO 12827 (signed 1992-12-30), set the report date to January 20, 1993. No held source gives the date the Commission submitted its report or an advisory-committee termination record. The filed claim's bound date 1997-09-30 is a day after EO 13062's signing date.

Missing source: the dated transmittal of the Secretary's final report to the President (and of the interim report). Sections 1 and 3 have no performance event and would end at the revocation.
